opportunities.title: Complete credentialed search and referral exports
opportunities.evidence: Search Console, Bing Webmaster, and referral/conversion metrics are unavailable, so the baseline cannot yet size demand, indexation health, CTR, or downstream conversion.
opportunities.experiment: Provide a supported 28-day and 90-day Search Console export, a Bing export where property access exists, and read-only aggregate analytics grouped by bounded referrer and page family.
opportunities.successCriteria: The next scorecard contains non-null provider metrics reconciled to their source exports, with no credentials or property identifiers committed.

opportunities.title: Expand the four-platform audit from one query to the reviewed panel
opportunities.evidence: All four named AI/search surfaces were observed for q01, but overall coverage is only 4 of 100 possible query-platform observations.
opportunities.experiment: Run the unchanged 25-query panel on the documented geography, locale, and signed-in schedule, prioritizing five queries per weekly pass.
opportunities.successCriteria: Every query has one observation on each required platform, and missing surfaces carry an explicit platform limitation rather than a zero.

opportunities.title: Correct and centralize AI-surfaced product facts
opportunities.evidence: The four answers used conflicting source, feed, layer, adoption, SDK, and feature counts; all were therefore marked mixed accuracy even when they cited World Monitor.
opportunities.experiment: Audit the cited homepage, explainer, pricing, machine-readable product files, and repository description against the canonical product-fact source before the next observation window.
opportunities.successCriteria: Repeated answers cite first-party pages with current, mutually consistent facts; mixed/inaccurate entity-answer observations decline without rewriting history.

opportunities.title: Earn a first-party Perplexity citation for the category query
opportunities.evidence: Perplexity mentioned World Monitor positively but cited only a third-party directory, while ChatGPT, Google AI, and Copilot linked first-party pages.
opportunities.experiment: Improve the first-party category explainer's dated evidence, visible source links, entity clarity, and internal path from homepage to explainer; then rerun q01 unchanged.
opportunities.successCriteria: Perplexity links a worldmonitor.app URL directly for q01 without paid placement, reciprocal-link manipulation, or a claim-only content rewrite.

opportunities.title: Gate new content on measured developer and use-case demand
opportunities.evidence: The reviewed set covers developer/MCP, chokepoint, country-risk, crisis, airspace, and supply-chain intents, but no credentialed impression, engagement, or conversion data is available yet.
opportunities.experiment: After exports arrive, rank q06-q15 by impressions, indexation health, qualified engagement, and credible product handoff; choose at most one evidence-rich report or page-family experiment.
opportunities.successCriteria: A new page or report proceeds only when demand, healthy indexation, useful engagement, and an intent-matched dashboard/API/MCP conversion path are all evidenced.

guardrails: Do not automate unauthorized search-result scraping.
Do not treat an AI mention without a worldmonitor.app source link as a direct citation.
Do not claim causal uplift from a single observation.
Do not store personal prompts, account identifiers, or sensitive query context.
Do not convert unavailable data to zero or estimate it from unrelated public results.
Do not expand the content corpus solely because an SEO vendor assigns a score.
Use UTM fields for internal acquisition attribution; ref= remains affiliate attribution.
